name: Bug report
about: Reproduce an observed project failure with sanitized evidence

---

Describe the concrete trigger, expected behavior and observed result.

Include source revision/dirty state, tool versions, build command and host OS.
For console reports include the fields in docs/HARDWARE-TEST.md, exact test
stage, firmware, controller identifiers, DualSense behavior and cleanup result.
Mark unmeasured facts Unknown. Attach sanitized logs; omit keys, addresses,
serials, game content and personal information.

List reproducible steps, repeat count and whether it also occurs without audio.
Use private vulnerability reporting, when available, for sensitive details.
